scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run migrate:cloudflare:experiment && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.migrate:cloudflare:experiment: npm run check:cloudflare:experiment && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --remote

BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Administrator email for the initial login.

BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password, 8 characters minimum and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Unique high-entropy JWT signing secret; keep it stable across deployments.

D1_BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: Independent private D1 gateway secret, at least 32 characters.

R2_BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: Independent private R2 gateway secret, at least 32 characters.

OPENTERMINALUI_PROVIDER_KEY_ENCRYPTION_K.description: Stable 44-character URL-safe Fernet key; back it up securely.
